# MDL000: mdl-syntax

> Generated: do not edit this page. Regenerate with `cargo dev gen rules`.

| Field | Value |

Lexical or syntax error, bad encoding, or a forbidden construct.

Covers invalid UTF-8, a byte-order mark, NUL, a bare CR, an unknown token, a keyword used as a name, a hand-written `baseline`, a bare `because "..."` and a slug rule alias. A syntax error becomes a `hole` and the rest of the file is still read.

## Examples

### MDL000 lexical or syntax error / A keyword used as a name fires #1 (line 8) (fire)

```text
grimble = "2";
module m;
node node : trusted {
}
```

### MDL000 lexical or syntax error / A well-formed model is clean #2 (line 17) (clean)

```text
grimble = "2";
module m;
node n : trusted {
}
```
